}\n588\t        })\n589\t        .collect()\n590\t}\n591\t\n592\t/// Check if two titles match (fuzzy comparison for dedup).\n593\t///\n594\t/// Considers titles matching if they are identical after true;\n599\t    }\n600\t\n601\t    // Normalize: remove common prefixes and compare.\n602\t    let normalize = |s: &str| -> String {\n603\t        s.trim()\n604\t            .trim_start_matches(|c: || p.contains(&e)\n612\t}\n613\t\n614\t/// Parse the mitosis depth from a bead's labels.\n615\t///\n616\t/// Returns the depth value if a mitosis-depth label exists and is valid,\n617\t/// otherwise .unwrap_or_default()\n640\t    );\n641\t\n642\t    // Patterns that indicate NEEDLE-internal configuration work.\n643\t    // These are derived from the real ARMOR incident (bead bf-3b64 and its false\n672\t}\n673\t\n674\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n675\t// Tests\n676\t// needle.mitosis.proposed_children = proposed.len() as u32,\n            needle.mitosis.children_created = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set based on result\n            needle.mitosis.children_skipped = tracing::field::Empty, // Will be set based on result\n        );\n        let _mitosis_enter = mitosis_span.enter();\n\n        // Read parent's existing children Labels\n        // are stored on the bead itself and survive FrankenSQLite index\n        // corruption, unlike dependency relationships. A crash mid-split (SIGKILL/OOM/eviction)\n        // rolls the whole thing back rather than leaving an orphaned child with\n        // no dependency link (plan.md Phase 5.3, Race 3). self.telemetry.emit(EventKind::MitosisSkipped {\n                parent_id: parent.id.clone(),\n                existing_children: existing.len() as u32,\n            })?;\n            return parent_id: parent.id.clone(),\n            children_created: created_ids.len() as u32,\n            children_skipped: skipped,\n            child_ids: created_ids.clone(),\n        })?;\n\n        // tracing::Span::current().record(\"needle.mitosis.children_skipped\", skipped);\n\n        tracing::info!(\n            parent_id = %parent.id,\n            children_created = created_ids.len(),\n            children_skipped = skipped,\n            \"mitosis split completed\"\n        );\n\n        Ok(MitosisResult::Split {\n            children: created_ids,\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Read the Result<u32> {\n        let labels =\n            match tokio::time::timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30), store.labels(bead_id))\n                .await\n            {\n                Ok(Ok(l)) bead_id = %bead_id,\n                        \"labels() timed out after 30s, assuming failure count 0\"\n                    );\n                    return Ok(0);\n                }\n            };\n\n        let count = labels\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(\"failure-count:\"))\n            .filter_map(|n| n.parse::<u32>().ok())\n            .max()\n            .unwrap_or(0);\n\n        Ok(count)\n    }\n\n    /// Get titles of existing children for a parent bead.\n    ///\n    /// Uses label-based discovery (`parent-<parent_id>` label) instead of\n    /// reading the parent's dependency list. This is robust against\n    /// FrankenSQLite index corruption where `br dep add` creates the\n    /// dependency link and labels but the relationship doesn't appear in\n    /// `br show --json` output.\n    ///\n    /// The `list_all()` call is wrapped in a timeout to prevent indefinite\n    /// hang in HANDLING state.\n    async fn get_existing_children(\n        &self,\n        store: &dyn BeadStore,\n        parent_id: &BeadId,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<String>> {\n        let parent_label = format!(\"parent-{}\", parent_id);\n        let all_beads = match tokio::time::timeout(\n            std::time::Duration::from_secs(30),\n            store.list_all(),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(Ok(beads)) => beads,\n            Ok(Err(e)) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    parent_id = %parent_id,\n                    error = %e,\n                    \"list_all failed during get_existing_children, assuming no children\"\n                );\n                return Ok(Vec::new());\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                tracing::warn!(\n                    parent_id = %parent_id,\n                    \"list_all timed out after 30s during get_existing_children, assuming no children\"\n                );\n                return Ok(Vec::new());\n            }\n        };\n\n        let titles: Vec<String> = all_beads\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|b| b.labels.iter().any(|l| l == &parent_label))\n            .map(|b| b.title.clone())\n            .collect();\n\n        Ok(titles)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Parsing\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Parse the agent's mitosis analysis response from stdout.\n///\n/// Searches for a JSON object in the output. Handles markdown code fencing\n/// and surrounding text.\nfn parse_mitosis_response(stdout: &str) -> Option<MitosisResponse> {\n    // Try direct JSON parse first.\n    if let Ok(resp) = serde_json::from_str::<MitosisResponse>(stdout.trim()) {\n        return Some(resp);\n    }\n\n    // Try extracting JSON from markdown code fences.\n    let json_str = extract_json_block(stdout)?;\n    serde_json::from_str::<MitosisResponse>(json_str).ok()\n}\n\n/// Extract a JSON object from text that may contain markdown code fences.\nfn extract_json_block(text: &str) -> Option<&str> {\n    // Look for ```json ... ``` or ``` ... ``` blocks.\n    if let Some(start) = text.find(\"```json\") {\n        let content_start = start + \"```json\".len();\n        if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n            return Some(text[content_start..content_start + end].trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    if let Some(start) = text.find(\"```\") {\n        let content_start = start + \"```\".len();\n        // Skip to next line if the opening ``` has text after it.\n        let content_start = text[content_start..]\n            .find('\\n')\n            .map(|n| content_start + n + 1)\n            .unwrap_or(content_start);\n        if let Some(end) = text[content_start..].find(\"```\") {\n            return Some(text[content_start..content_start + end].trim());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Try to find a bare JSON object.\n    let trimmed = text.trim();\n    if trimmed.starts_with('{') {\n        // Find matching closing brace (simple heuristic).\n        let mut depth = 0i32;\n        for (i, ch) in trimmed.char_indices() {\n            match ch {\n                '{' => depth += 1,\n                '}' => {\n                    depth -= 1;\n                    if depth == 0 {\n                        return Some(&trimmed[..=i]);\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    None\n}\n\n/// Sanitize a path string for use as a filename component.\nfn sanitize_path_component(s: &str) -> String {\n    s.chars()\n        .map(|c| {\n            if c.is_alphanumeric() || c == '-' || c == '_' {\n                c\n            } else {\n                '_'\n            }\n        })\n        .collect()\n}\n\n/// Check if two titles match (fuzzy comparison for dedup).\n///\n/// Considers titles matching if they are identical after normalization,\n/// or if one contains the other as a substring.\nfn titles_match(existing: &str, proposed: &str) -> bool {\n    if existing == proposed {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    // Normalize: remove common prefixes and compare.\n    let normalize = |s: &str| -> String {\n        s.trim()\n            .trim_start_matches(|c: char| !c.is_alphabetic())\n            .to_lowercase()\n    };\n\n    let e = normalize(existing);\n    let p = normalize(proposed);\n\n    e == p || e.contains(&p) || p.contains(&e)\n}\n\n/// Parse the mitosis depth from a bead's labels.\n///\n/// Returns the depth value if a mitosis-depth label exists and is valid,\n/// otherwise returns 0 (indicating this is not a mitosis child).\nfn parse_mitosis_depth(bead: &Bead) -> u32 {\n    bead.labels\n        .iter()\n        .filter_map(|l| l.strip_prefix(\"mitosis-depth:\"))\n        .filter_map(|n| n.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        .max()\n        .unwrap_or(0)\n}\n\n/// Detect if a bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration.\n///\n/// Returns true if the bead content suggests investigating or fixing NEEDLE's own\n/// dispatch configuration (Pluck, exclude_labels, bead discovery, etc.).\n/// These tasks have no legitimate resolution path from inside a target repo.\npub fn detects_needle_internal_config(bead: &Bead) -> bool {\n    let combined_text = format!(\n        \"{} {}\",\n        bead.title.to_lowercase(),\n        bead.body\n            .as_ref()\n            .map(|b| b.to_lowercase())\n            .unwrap_or_default()\n    );\n\n    // Patterns that indicate NEEDLE-internal configuration work.\n    // These are derived from the real ARMOR incident (bead bf-3b64 and its lineage).\n    let internal_config_patterns = [\n        \"pluck configuration\",\n        \"pluck config\",\n        \"exclude_labels\",\n        \"exclude labels\",\n        \"bead discovery\",\n        \"starvation alert\",\n        \"beads invisible to worker\",\n        \"open beads exist but pluck found none\",\n        \"needle dispatch\",\n        \"strand configuration\",\n        \"worker configuration\",\n        \"bead filtering\",\n        \"candidate exclusion\",\n    ];\n\n    for pattern in &internal_config_patterns {\n        if combined_text.contains(pattern) {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                bead_id = %bead.id,\n                pattern,\n                \"bead references NEEDLE-internal configuration\"\n            );\n            return true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    false\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Tests\n// At least one must be set.\n/// Hooks are fire-and-forget — failures are logged but never block the worker.\n///\n/// # Example\n/// ```yaml\n/// telemetry:\n///   hooks:\n///     - event_filter: \"outcome.*\"\n///       command: \"/path/to/alert.sh\"\n///     - event_filter: \"worker.errored\"\n///       url: \"https://hooks.slack.com/services/...\"\n///     - event_filter: \"effort.recorded\"\n///       command: \"/path/to/cost-tracker.sh\"\n///       url: \"https://dashboard.example.com/ingest\"\n/// ```\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct HookConfig {\n    /// Glob pattern matched against `event_type` (e.g. `\"outcome.*\"`).\n    pub event_filter: String,\n\n    /// Shell command to execute. (native webhook support).\n    /// `Content-Type: application/json` is set automatically.\n    /// Omit when dispatching only to `command`.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub url: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// OTLP sink configuration for OpenTelemetry export.\n///\n/// When enabled, NEEDLE exports traces, metrics, and logs to any OTLP-compliant\n/// collector (e.g., Grafana Tempo, Jaeger, OpenTelemetry Collector).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct OtlpSinkConfig {\n    /// Enable or disable the OTLP sink.\n    #[serde(default = pub endpoint: String,\n\n    /// Protocol: \"grpc\" or \"http\".\n    #[serde(default = \"OtlpSinkConfig::default_protocol\")]\n    pub protocol: String,\n\n    /// Request timeout in seconds (default: 10).\n    #[serde(default = \"OtlpSinkConfig::default_timeout_secs\")]\n    pub timeout_secs: u64,\n\n    /// Compression: \"gzip\", \"none\", or \"zstd\".\n    #[serde(default = \"OtlpSinkConfig::default_compression\")]\n    pub compression: String,\n\n    /// TLS configuration: \"none\", \"tls\", or \"mtls\".\n    #[serde(default = \"OtlpSinkConfig::default_tls\")]\n    pub signals (format: \"key=value\").\n    /// Reserved keys `service.name` and `service.instance.id` cannot be overridden.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub resource_attributes: Vec<String>,\n\n    /// Metrics export interval in seconds (default: 10).\n    #[serde(default = \"OtlpSinkConfig::default_metrics_interval_secs\")]\n    pub metrics_interval_secs: u64,\n\n    /// Service namespace for OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.\n    /// Defaults to \"needle-fleet\" if not specified.\n    #[serde(default = \"OtlpSinkConfig::default_service_namespace\")]\n    pub service_namespace: String,\n\n    /// Maximum queue size for batch processors (default: 2048).\n    /// When the queue fills, the OTel SDK drops the oldest items.\n    #[serde(default = \"OtlpSinkConfig::default_max_queue_size\")]\n    pub max_queue_size: usize,\n}\n\nimpl Default for OtlpSinkConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        OtlpSinkConfig {\n            enabled: Self::default_enabled(),\n            endpoint: Self::default_endpoint(),\n            protocol: Self::default_protocol(),\n            timeout_secs: Self::default_timeout_secs(),\n            compression: Self::default_compression(),\n            tls: Self::default_tls(),\n            headers: Vec::new(),\n            resource_attributes: Vec::new(),\n            metrics_interval_secs: Self::default_metrics_interval_secs(),\n            service_namespace: Self::default_service_namespace(),\n            max_queue_size: Self::default_max_queue_size(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl OtlpSinkConfig {\n    fn default_enabled() -> bool {\n        false\n    }\n\n    fn default_endpoint() -> String {\n        \"http://localhost:4317\".to_string()\n    }\n\n    fn default_protocol() -> String {\n        \"grpc\".to_string()\n    }\n\n    fn default_timeout_secs() -> u64 {\n        10\n    }\n\n    fn default_compression() -> String {\n        \"gzip\".to_string()\n    }\n\n    fn default_tls() -> String {\n        \"none\".to_string()\n    }\n\n    fn default_metrics_interval_secs() -> u64 {\n        10\n    }\n\n    fn default_service_namespace() -> String {\n        \"needle-fleet\".to_string()\n    }\n\n    fn default_max_queue_size() -> usize {\n        2048\n    }\n}\n\n/// Telemetry configuration.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub None\n    }\n\n    fn default_socket_path() -> Option<PathBuf> {\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// Returns the resolved heartbeat path, defaulting to `workspace.home/state/supervisor-heartbeat.json`.\n    pub fn resolved_heartbeat_path(&self, workspace_home: &Path) -> PathBuf {\n        self.heartbeat_path\n            .clone()\n            .unwrap_or_else(|| workspace_home.join(\"state/supervisor-heartbeat.json\"))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Per-provider concurrency and rate limits.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct  fn default_quarantine_after_failures() -> u32 {\n        5\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config Source Tracking\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Where a configuration value originated.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ConfigSource {\n    /// Built-in default value.\n    Default,\n    /// Global config file (`~/.config/needle/config.yaml`).\n    GlobalFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Workspace config file (`.needle.yaml`).\n    WorkspaceFile(PathBuf),\n    /// Environment variable override.\n    EnvVar(String),\n    /// CLI argument override.\n    CliOverride,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigSource {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            ConfigSource::Default => write!(f, \"built-in default\"),\n            ConfigSource::GlobalFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::WorkspaceFile(p) => write!(f, \"{}\", p.display()),\n            ConfigSource::EnvVar(name) => write!(f, \"{} env var\", name),\n            ConfigSource::CliOverride => write!(f, \"CLI argument\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Map of config field paths to their source.\n///\n/// Used by `needle config --dump --show-source` to annotate each value.\npub type SourceMap = BTreeMap<String, ConfigSource>;\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Workspace Overrides\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Subset of configuration that can be overridden per-workspace via `.needle.yaml`.\n///\n/// Only these sections are allowed at the workspace level:\n/// - `agent.default`, `agent.timeout`\n/// - `strands` (weave, pulse, unravel)\n/// - `prompt.*`\n/// - `verification` (legacy) or `gates` (new pluggable    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: Option<WorkspaceAgentOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: Option<WorkspaceStrandsOverrides>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: The path fields (`default`, `home`) are simply ignored if set.\nconst NON_OVERRIDABLE_KEYS: &[&str] = &[\"worker\", \"limits\", \"health\", \"telemetry\"];\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Top-level Config\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fully resolved NEEDLE configuration.\n///\n/// Loaded once at boot, immutable during a session.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Config {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub agent: AgentConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub worker: WorkerConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub workspace: WorkspaceConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub strands: StrandsConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub telemetry: TelemetryConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub prompt: PromptConfig,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub health: HealthConfig,\n    /// Provider/model concurrency and rate limits.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub limits: LimitsConfig,\n    /// Per-model token pricing (USD per million tokens).\n    #[serde(default = \"crate::cost::default_pricing\")]\n    pub pricing: PricingConfig,\n    /// Daily budget thresholds for cost enforcement.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub budget: BudgetConfig,\n    /// Verification commands run after agent success, before accepting closure.\n    /// Legacy format — prefer `gates` for new configurations.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub verification: Vec<String>,\n    /// Pluggable validation gates.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub gates: Vec<GateConfig>,\n    /// Self-modification (hot-reload) configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub self_modification: SelfModificationConfig,\n    /// FABRIC live dashboard forwarding.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub fabric: FabricConfig,\n    /// Supervisor detection configuration.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub supervisor: SupervisorConfig,\n    /// Outcome handling configuration (failure circuit-breaker).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub outcome: OutcomeConfig,\n    /// Per-worker tsnet identity provisioning.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub tsnet: crate::tsnet::TsnetConfig,\n}\n\nimpl Config {\n    /// Expand all tilde (~) paths to absolute paths using $HOME.\n    ///\n    /// This must be called after deserialization to ensure all paths\n    /// like `~/.needle` are expanded to `/home/user/.needle`.\n    /// Paths without tildes are left unchanged.\n    pub fn expand_tildes(&mut self) {\n        // workspace section\n        self.workspace.default = expand_tilde(&self.workspace.default);\n        self.workspace.home = expand_tilde(&self.workspace.home);\n\n        // agent section\n        self.agent.adapters_dir = expand_tilde(&self.agent.adapters_dir);\n\n        // strands.explore section\n        self.strands.explore.workspace_root = expand_tilde(&self.strands.explore.workspace_root);\n        self.strands.explore.workspaces = expand_tilde_vec(&self.strands.explore.workspaces);\n\n        // strands.weave section\n        self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces =\n            expand_tilde_vec(&self.strands.weave.exclude_workspaces);\n\n        // strands.splice section\n        self.strands.splice.report_workspace =\n            expand_tilde_option(&self.strands.splice.report_workspace);\n\n        // strands.pulse.scanners[].command paths are strings, not PathBuf, so skip\n\n        // strands.reflect section - no PathBuf fields\n\n        // strands.learning section\n        self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file =\n            expand_tilde(&self.strands.learning.global_learnings_file);\n\n        // telemetry section\n        if let Some(ref mut log_dir) = self.telemetry.file_sink.log_dir {\n            *log_dir = expand_tilde(log_dir);\n        }\n\n        // health section\n        self.health.heartbeat_dir = expand_tilde_option(&self.health.heartbeat_dir);\n\n        // supervisor section\n        self.supervisor.heartbeat_path = expand_tilde_option(&self.supervisor.heartbeat_path);\n        self.supervisor.socket_path = expand_tilde_option(&self.supervisor.socket_path);\n\n        // prompt section\n        self.prompt.context_files = expand_tilde_vec(&self.prompt.context_files);\n\n        // self_modification section\n        self.self_modification.canary_workspace =\n            expand_tilde(&self.self_modification.canary_workspace);\n\n        // prompt.variants[].content_file\n        for variants in self.prompt.variants.values_mut() {\n            for variant in variants {\n                variant.content_file = expand_tilde(&variant.content_file);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// Config validation\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A single config validation error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ConfigError {\n    /// Dot-separated field path (e.g., `agent.default`).\n    pub field: String,\n    /// Human-readable explanation.\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ConfigError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"{}: {}\", self.field, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// CLI overrides\n// Option<PathBuf>,\n}\n\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n// ConfigLoader\n// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Loads and validates NEEDLE configuration.\npub struct ConfigLoader;\n\nimpl ConfigLoader {\n    /// Load global
